newsitem.title: USA: U.S. options exchanges to list Hutchinson Tech.
newsitem.headline: U.S. options exchanges to list Hutchinson Tech.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE), American Stock Exchange (AMEX), Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) and Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Wednesday they would start trading options on shares of Hutchinson Technology Inc on February 20.
The exchanges said opening strike prices would be at 30, 35 and 40, with expirations in March, April, May and August.
Position limits of 10,500 contracts have been set at the AMEX, PHLX and PSE.
Hutchinson shares ended up 1-1/2 at 34 Wednesday.
At the CBOE, Hutchinson options would trade in the National Semiconductor Corp crowd.
Cohen, Duffy & McGowan Inc has been named the specialist unit at the AMEX and Susquehanna Investment Group has been named specialist for the options at the PHLX.
On the PSE, the options have been allocated to pit representative James Burleson in the Octel Communications Corp crowd.
